what: Three checker models label 150 claim-and-quote pairs. A third of the pairs were broken on purpose when built.
human_labels: NOT DONE. No person has labelled these pairs, so there is no agreement-with-a-human figure.

second_model.labeller: Claude Fable 5.2, shown only the claim and the quote. NOT a person.
second_model.caveat: This is one model agreeing with another from the same family. It says the checker is consistent with a stronger model; it does not say either is right. Convention used: a pronoun in the quote that plainly refers to the page's subject is not counted as a missing fact, but an added number, date, cause or 'who said it' is.
